title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: A considered gift connects the occasion with its later use. Ask not just where the logo should sit, but when the object will next be picked up. Materials, form and packaging can tell one story. Recipients, quantity and the required delivery date give development a practical framework.

title.html: Choose an object that suits the occasion

body.html: A luggage tag accompanies business travel; a keyring becomes part of a daily routine. The right choice depends on the recipient and the occasion. We help develop a coherent gift from an existing product format or a bespoke idea. Several pieces can also be planned as a coordinated gift set.

Material colour, branding placement and hardware shape the result. Blind debossing keeps the identity discreet; foil stamping adds a deliberate accent. Our luggage tags can be specified with custom shapes, gold- or silver-coloured buckles and more than one logo. Each detail is agreed for the selected product.

title.html: From a single gift to a coordinated set

body.html: We welcome a personal one-off and very small gift runs, with capacity for substantial event and brand projects too. Each piece is handmade in the EU, with product, packaging and presentation considered together. Include your required date early so that material selection, sampling and approvals can inform the schedule.
